Chapter 493 - 493 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (2)

Chapter 493 - 493 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (2)

493 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (2)

After all, it was rare to see each other, so they had to take a stroll.

When the two of them walked out of KM Mall, they were carrying large and small bags of Chanel, Lancome, Gucci, and other clothes and jewelry.

When Lin Fan returned to Coiling Dragon Villa, it was already nighttime.

…

A day passed in the blink of an eye.

On Sunday, Lin Fan sat on the sofa after breakfast. He played with his phone and drank some Spirit Tea. He felt refreshed and relaxed.

At this moment, his phone rang.

He glanced at the caller ID. It was Wang Fugui, the chairman of Yadi Automobile.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Hello, Mr. Lin,” Wang Fugui said respectfully.

Respectful?

That was right!

Respectful!

On one hand, Lin Fan was the biggest shareholder of Yadi Automobile.

On the other hand, it was because of Lin Fan’s many inventions—the earthquake prediction device, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, the super battery… Which one of them did not shock the world?

Anyone would treat such a great scientist and scholar with respect.

Lin Fan said, “Hello.”

Then, he asked bluntly, “Chairman Wang, why are you calling?”

Wang Fugui had interacted with Lin Fan before and knew that he was a straightforward person.

Therefore, he said directly, “Mr. Lin, yesterday, we installed the super battery on the first car and passed all the performance tests!

“After our tests, we’ve obtained data. The endurance of this pure electric car can reach 3,000 kilometers!”

When he said this, Wang Fugui’s tone clearly became high-spirited.

Pride and excitement surged crazily!

It was no wonder that he would be like this.

What did 3,000 kilometers mean?

That meant that one only needed to charge the car once to drive from the east to the west of Hua Nation!

This was already far beyond the capabilities of a gasoline car!

People often said that gasoline cars would eventually be eliminated by new energy vehicles.

However, no one knew when it would happen.

Now, Wang Fugui could clearly tell everyone that it was time for the elimination!

He could almost imagine the grand scene of electric cars being driven by countless people!

The era that belonged to Yadi Automobile had arrived!

Compared to Wang Fugui’s excitement, Lin Fan was much calmer.

“Is that so?” he said casually. “Not bad, right?”

One had to know…

The super battery was invented by him.

Lin Fan already knew the exact numbers.

Now, Wang Fugui was only putting it into practice.

What was there to be happy about?

When Wang Fugui heard Lin Fan’s voice, he snapped back to his senses.

He cleared his throat and said, “Mr. Lin, I’ve already sent the first electric car to you. It should be here today. You can feel the effect when the time comes.”

“Alright then,” Lin Fan said.

Then, Wang Fugui started chatting with Lin Fan.

However, Lin Fan did not have the intention to chat.

He only casually echoed a few words before hanging up the phone.

At this moment, a muffled sound came from outside.

A tow truck arrived outside Coiling Dragon’s villa. On top of the tow truck was a very cool electric supercar.

This… It was the first Yadi super-electric car that Wang Fugui had mentioned.

The tow truck driver was very smug along the way. After all, he was transporting a cool super sports car.

All the passerby’s attention was drawn to it.

However, when he arrived at the villa, the pride in his heart was completely thrown aside.

This was because all that could be seen here were luxury cars.

Bentley, Ferrari, Lamborghini…

Among them, there were more than ten Rolls-Royce.

He even saw a private helicopter!

The tow truck driver thought to himself, ‘The people who live here are really rich!’

Seeing that the tow truck driver did not move, Lin Fan walked out and said, “Did Yadi Automobile ask you to send it over?”

“Yes,” The tow truck driver said. “Mr. Lin, may I ask where you want to leave the car?”

“Oh, put it wherever you want. The villas here are all mine,” Lin Fan said casually.

All his?

There were nearly ten villas here!

Also, these luxury cars and private planes all belonged to Mr. Lin?

Being poor really limited his imagination!

The tow truck driver was stunned for a moment before he said, “Alright… Alright.”

When the tow truck driver put down the car, a black Audi slowly stopped at the entrance of the Coiling Dragon Villa.

A middle-aged man in a white shirt strode over.

It was the director of the Institute of Science, Feng Zhixiang, who had interacted with Lin Fan several times.

“Professor Lin, you’re here,” Feng Zhixiang said happily.”

“You bought a sports car again? There are so many cars. Can you drive all of them?”

Lin Fan said, “There are many cars here that I didn’t buy. I didn’t buy this car either. The chairman of Yadi Automobile, Wang Fugui, got someone to give it to me.”

“Yadi Automobile?” Feng Zhixiang said in surprise.

He had naturally heard of Yadi Automobile.

In the past, Yadi focused on producing low-end fuel cars.

In recent years, after the country called for new energy vehicles, it put all its focus on new energy vehicles.

However, when did Yadi Automobile produce sports cars?

“Doesn’t Yadi Automobile mainly produce new energy vehicles now? Now it’s making sports cars?” Feng Zhixiang could not help but say it out loud.

“This is a new energy car. Wang Fugui just called to say that it can drive 3,000 kilometers on one charge.”

“What? 3,000 kilometers!” Feng Zhixiang’s eyes widened in disbelief.

3,000 kilometers was a terrifying number.

Then, Feng Zhixiang seemed to have thought of something and hurriedly said, “Is it using the super battery you invented?”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.”

After receiving Lin Fan’s affirmation, Feng Zhi Xiang’s eyes were still wide open. His face was filled with disbelief.

“Endurance of 3,000 kilometers. 3, 000 kilometers… It’s actually done… This… Only the legendary controllable nuclear fusion should be able to do this, right?” Feng Zhixiang muttered to himself.

When Lin Fan heard this, he was slightly stunned.

That was because a crisp notification suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve triggered a mission—build a nuclear fusion plant that’s more than 10,000 acres, own a Totamac device, and read Particle Simulation of Plasmas, Manual of Plasma Physics and Formulas, Thermonuron Fusion Plasma Physics, and Controlled Nuclear Fusion. Rewards: Complete version of the controllable nuclear fusion device, as well as related knowledge such as principles and design drawings, +1 upgrade Professor-Level Physics Experience, and one platinum packet.]

Building a 10,000-acre nuclear fusion plant would undoubtedly cost a lot of money.

However, to Lin Fan, was a problem that could be solved with money a problem?

Possessing a Totamac device? Hua Nation did not have one at all. Lin Fan did not know how to design one either. He needed to think of a way.

As for flipping through books, that was too simple.

Lin Fan looked at the rewards, and his lips curled up.

Not a bad mission!

Lin Fan was in a good mood. He looked at Feng Zhixiang and said, “Director Feng, why are you here today?”

After Feng Zhixiang heard Lin Fan’s question, he came back to his senses.

He cleared his throat and said somewhat embarrassed, “Professor Lin, you said last time that you have advanced versions of prosthetic limbs…”

When Lin Fan heard this, he immediately understood what he meant.

Last time, Feng Zhixiang mentioned that he wanted to let a group of disabled soldiers who were injured during battle use advanced prosthetic limbs to form a special battle team.

“Have you gathered all the disabled soldiers?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes,” Feng Zhixiang quickly said.

In fact, he had gathered all of them a long time ago.

He did not dare to rush Lin Fan and could only let the soldiers wait silently.

However, this wait lasted for more than half a month.

The soldiers could not help but feel anxious.

Therefore, Feng Zhixiang had no choice but to personally come over to ask.

Right now, Lin Fan was in a good mood.

After all, he had just triggered a pretty good mission.

Moreover, this mission was also partly because of Feng Zhixiang.

Therefore, he did not hesitate and said, “I’ll send you the prosthetic limbs in a few days.”

“Thank you, Professor Lin!” Feng Zhixiang said happily.
